name: Kitakyushu

queries.query: 北九州市 地番図 地籍図 公図 GIS 公開 地図 公式
queries.scope: Find a current official Kitakyushu cadastral parcel map and anonymous polygon service.
queries.result: The city describes its cadastral survey program and resulting parcel maps/ledgers. Its public tax-information page allows anyone to view an attached map (附属図) for a fee, but at the responsible tax office or via formal request. The official GIS page links the G-motty map hub for urban planning, road network, road-width and other administrative maps; no anonymous full parcel geometry endpoint was found.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search plus read-only inspection of anonymous public map/service routes.

portals.name: Kitakyushu City GIS / G-motty
portals.operator: City of Kitakyushu and regional G-motty information portal
portals.observation: Official city page links GIS and open-data hubs. Its public ArcGIS Experience item is a regional information portal; reviewed city map categories include urban planning, road maps and fixed-asset land-value visualizations, not a full parcel feature service.

portals.name: City cadastral survey and fixed-asset map appendices
portals.observation: Official city explains cadastral survey maps and land ledgers. A separate tax-map appendix is available for public viewing for a fee through the responsible tax office or by request; no digital vector export endpoint was identified.

requests.observation: Official city page links GIS and open-data portals.
Official cadastral survey page describes one-lot land-boundary survey and preparation of cadastral maps/ledgers; it is an overview rather than a feature service.
Official fixed-asset information page says anyone may view the appendix map for a fee at the responsible city tax office or request a copy; no anonymous remote geometry endpoint is linked.
Public ArcGIS item metadata identifies a published G-motty regional information portal maintained by Kitakyushu; it is a public map hub, not a parcel feature-layer schema.
